title: BOLTWORKS
own_art_list: Runtime-synthesized SFX and looping BGM via Web Audio API — no external audio files, no Atlas assets
what_i_found: The tank is not a single mesh but a kit of verified 404 modules—hull, tracks, turret, barrel and armour—that automatically disassembles and physically rebuilds between waves. The silhouette visibly changes over a run as heavier hulls, longer barrels and bolted armour are swapped in. Because the tank is code, the rebuild is immediate and variation costs no additional meshes.
